synopsis: On exoplanet HD 189733b, screaming supersonic winds blast glowing molten glass horizontally across a deep blue atmosphere.
narration: On exoplanet HD 189733b, winds howl at eight thousand kilometers per hour while molten glass rains sideways across cobalt skies. Silicate vapor condenses into lethal razor-sharp storms, painting this cobalt blue hellscape with glowing, horizontal rain.

shots.prompt: A majestic wide view of deep cobalt blue gas giant HD 189733b against dark starfields, violently ripped by glowing turquoise atmospheric bands moving at terrifying speed, camera slowly drifting inward.

Extreme close camera push through dense glowing blue clouds, revealing streaks of incandescent liquid glass flying sideways horizontally across the frame at hypersonic velocity, illuminated by distant starlight.
Macro view of glowing silicate droplets rushing endlessly past the camera into the dark horizon of the planet, smoothly looping back to the framing and orbit trajectory of the first shot.

music: An awe-driven deep space synth pulse with a steady forward rhythm and shimmering harmonic atmospheric pads, swelling dramatically with intense cinematic brass textures as horizontal storm streaks rush past, resolving into a deep continuous rhythmic hum that cuts abruptly mid-beat to create a seamless loop.
